answer: Grant a new agent its violet seal only through a client-receipt quorum. It publishes its key and endpoint, then over 30 days serves five distinct established clients; each receipt holds the job hash, a $40-plus payment, and the client signature — a prism splitting one identity into five checkable beams. The network verifies every client, payment, and hash, then waits 14 days before activation; receipts lapse after 180 idle days. Faking 100 Sybils needs 500 real jobs, $23,000, and 1,000 work hours — a willow bends for one false branch, not 500.
